structural_change: S81U-CAP2: the flat s81sl_cap failed the clock rule (22,261 sinks / one root, TT insertion 368.5 ps > 300, physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap/gate_result.json); split into 2 x tree leaf (s81sl_cap_tr, one master, E instance MY) + root leaf (s81sl_cap_rt) with own clock roots and registered seams (nc RST flop -> n6 P1 flop, no added edge), parent s81sl_capc = instances + wiring. S81U-CAP4: route 9df7f8153 NEEDS_RTL FF hold -6.37 ps (TT +77.56) = class (a) internal flop -> INV -> flop pass hops (188 violators, 93 in the nodes' 5-deep u_fsb/u_asb side-band shift lanes; capture clock ~14 ps after launch on sibling CTS branches, data 44 ps); hold ECO 7,489 cells -> -1.0. Fix: nodes DLR=1 -> those lanes are cycle-exact register-file delay lines (ot_hdc_delay_rf D=6: no zero-logic flop->flop hop, same flops, 0 edges).

reroute_reason.why: Route s81sl_cap_tr-s81sl_cap_tr-9df7f8153 NEEDS_RTL: TT +77.56 / FF hold -6.37 ps (hold ECO least-bad -1.0 after 7,489 cells; 5,740 of 6,200 endpoints below the 38 ps ECO margin). Hold class (a), internal flop -> flop: all 188 FF violators are zero-logic flop -> INV -> flop pass hops (worst g_l1[1].u_n.u_add.s3_code[26] -> s4_code[26], launch clock 97.6 ps / capture 111.8 ps at FF on sibling CTS branches, data 43.7 ps vs 25 unc + 13.7 hold); 93 of them in the three nodes' 5-deep u_fsb/u_asb side-band shift lanes; worst in->reg +28.4, out +27.2 (no IO/clock-entry class). Fix (structural, 0 edges, same flops): ot_s81_retn_static DLR=1 in the tree leaf runs those lanes as cycle-exact register-file delay lines ot_hdc_delay_rf D=6 (H-IDX precedent): rows written once and read through the 4:1 mux, so no zero-logic hop remains there (~1,250 pass hops removed). cap_bench base real1/small/rand2/rand3 PASS (latency 43..84 unchanged), MUT1-4 detected (results/rtl/s81_slice_1017/cap_cap4/); --cts gate WARN (reset-relay fanout only), TT 150.3/21.9 ps.
